title: Affine-cover criterion for tensor module flatness after base change
statement: Let $A,T$ be commutative rings, $X,Y$ schemes [def-pc-scheme], $f:X\to\operatorname{Spec}(A)$ a morphism, and $M$ a quasi-coherent $\mathcal O_X$-module [pqf-def-coherent]. Let $U_b$, $b\in\operatorname{Fin}(n)$, be specified affine opens covering $X$. Set $a_b:A\to\Gamma(X,U_b)$ to the map induced by $f$, using the canonical spectrum-sections isomorphism. Let $q:A\to T$, $p:Y\to\operatorname{Spec}(A)$, and $e:Y\simeq\operatorname{Spec}(T)$ satisfy $\operatorname{Spec}(q)\circ e=p$. Put $D=T\otimes_A A$, with the right $A$-algebra structure, and restrict $\Gamma(M,U_b)$ along $a_b$. The tensor pullback of $M$ [def-pc-module-pullback] to $X\times_{\operatorname{Spec}(A)}Y$ is flat over $Y$ [def-pc-scheme-module-flat-over] if and only if every $D\otimes_A\Gamma(M,U_b)$ is flat over $D$. No finiteness of section rings or modules, limit diagram, or eventual-flatness assertion is assumed or concluded.

source.place: Morphisms, lemma-flat-module, (2) equivalent to (4); Algebra Tag 00HT, prime-local criterion; Limits Tag 05LY, affine-local reduction

proof.text: Cancel the redundant right-unit ring D=T tensor_A A using the private Lean helper flat_tensor_right_unit_iff. Its proof checks the right A-scalar action by tensor balancing, uses Algebra.TensorProduct.rid to make D a localization of T at the trivial submonoid, applies Module.flat_iff_of_isLocalization, and applies the induced T-linear tensor equivalence. Thus each displayed D-flatness test is equivalent to T-flatness of T tensor_A Gamma(M,U_b).

Compare tensorPullback(fst) with Mathlib module pullback by uniqueness of the left adjoint to pushforward. Transfer quasi-coherence along that isomorphism. Relative flatness of the pullback gives flatness of each stalk by relative_flat_module_stalk. Restrict these stalk tests to the inverse image of each U_b and apply affine_pullback_chart_tensor_flat_iff_stalks in its reverse direction, then the right-unit equivalence, proving every tensor flatness test.

Conversely, apply the right-unit equivalence and the forward direction of affine_pullback_chart_tensor_flat_iff_stalks on each chart. At an arbitrary pullback point z, hcover applied to fst(z) gives a chart U_b containing it, hence the required relative-flat stalk test at z. The already established quasi-coherence lets relative_flat_of_stalks recover IsFlatOver. This argument includes n=0: a hypothetical point would produce an impossible Fin 0 index.

proof_origin.place: Affine-chart flatness criterion; Lean reduction by cancelling T tensor_A A and gluing relative stalk tests via the given cover.

mathlib_searches.query: A quasi coherent sheaf of modules is relatively flat after base change if and only if its affine cover section tensor products are flat modules
Flatness of a quasi coherent module on a scheme over an affine base can be checked on tensor scalar extensions of sections on a finite affine open cover

lean.statement: theorem affine_cover_module_tensor_flat_criterion (A T : CommRingCat.{u}) {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Spec A) (M : X.Modules) [M.IsQuasicoherent] {n : ℕ} (U : Fin n → X.affineOpens) (hcover : ∀ x : X, ∃ b, x ∈ (U b).1) (q : A ⟶ T) (p : Y ⟶ Spec A) (e : Y ≅ Spec T) (he : e.hom ≫ Spec.map q = p) : let a := fun b ↦ ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso A).inv ≫ f.appLE ⊤ (U b).1 (by simp)).hom Scheme.Modules.IsFlatOver ((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback (pullback.fst f p)).obj M) (pullback.snd f p) ↔ (∀ b, letI : Module (A : Type u) Γ(M, (U b).1) := Module.compHom _ (a b) letI : Algebra (A : Type u) (T : Type u) := q.hom.toAlgebra letI : Algebra (A : Type u) ((T : Type u) ⊗[(A : Type u)] (A : Type u)) := Algebra.TensorProduct.rightAlgebra letI : Module (A : Type u) ((T : Type u) ⊗[(A : Type u)] (A : Type u)) := Algebra.toModule Module.Flat ((T : Type u) ⊗[(A : Type u)] (A : Type u)) (((T : Type u) ⊗[(A : Type u)] (A : Type u)) ⊗[(A : Type u)] Γ(M, (U b).1)))
